hero.subtitle: We are getting married
story.title: Our Story
story.quote: This time, with no return ticket.
story.p1: We met in Philadelphia in July 2024, at an international convention. One of us lived in the Netherlands, the other in Sicily: definitely not the easiest way to start a love story!
story.p2: For one of us, it was love at first sight. For the other... let's just say it only took a year and a half to come around!
story.p3: Thanks to a network of friends, a few coincidences and a little determination, he finally found a good excuse to come back to Italy and an even better reason to ask for a video call: a little advice about planning his trip. Needless to say, we didn't spend much time talking about the trip!
story.p4: After that call, we decided to stop looking for reasons not to give it a try and start looking for flights to see each other instead. And so began the airports, suitcases, check-ins, connecting flights and trips across Europe.
story.p5: Together, we travelled around 31,000 km by plane, met each other's families and discovered, mile after mile, that it was all absolutely worth it.
story.p6: In October 2026, on a cliff in Puglia, with the sun setting in the background, the big question was finally asked. The answer? "Finally!"
story.p7: Because after all those miles, airports and countless goodbyes, we couldn't wait to begin our greatest journey yet: a lifetime together.
story.p8: And so, from Philadelphia to Puglia, here we are, ready to celebrate our love and write the next chapter of our story.

travel.title: Location & Travel Info
travel.flights.title: Flights to Puglia
travel.flights.desc: The closest airports are Brindisi (BDS), approximately 30 minutes away, and Bari (BRI), approximately 1.5 hours away from Lecce. Both airports offer excellent direct flight connections across Europe.
travel.hotels.title: Stay in Lecce
travel.hotels.desc: Lecce offers a wide selection of boutique hotels, B&Bs, and authentic Masserias. We recommend staying near the historic center (Centro Storico) for the best experience.
travel.lecce.title: Discover Lecce
travel.lecce.desc: Famous for its golden baroque architecture, delicious cuisine, and charming streets. Feel free to extend your stay and explore Puglia!
guest.title: Guest Corner
guest.dietary.title: Allergies & Dietary Needs
guest.dietary.text: Please let us know about any food allergies or dietary requirements ahead of time. Sharing them early helps us plan the menu and make sure everyone is well taken care of throughout the celebration.
guest.photos.title: Share Wedding Day Pictures
guest.photos.text: Capture candid shots, celebration moments, photobooth fun, and Polaroids, then upload them to our shared Google Photos album on the wedding day. We’d love to see the day through your eyes!
